mapper.select: SELECT ph.product_holding_id, ph.account_id, ph.product_id, fp.product_name, fp.product_type, ph.quantity, ph.avg_nav, ph.purchase_amount, ph.update_at FROM product_holding ph JOIN financial_product fp ON ph.product_id = fp.product_id WHERE ph.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY ph.update_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_holding(account_id, product_id, quantity, avg_nav, purchase_amount, update_at) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{avgNav}, #{purchaseAmount}, #{updateAt})
